name: Clortermine
summary: Clortermine (Voranil) was developed by Ciba in the 1960s and is an anorectic drug of the amphetamine class. It is the 2-chloro analogue of the better-known appetite suppressant phentermine and is the 2-chloro positional isomer of chlorphentermine. Clortermine produces very low rates of self-administration in animals similarly to chlorphentermine, and as a result it likely does not act on dopamine.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in detail. Appetite suppressants of its class can cause dry mouth, sleeplessness, irritability, a fast heartbeat and raised blood pressure.
sideEffects.zh: 關於它的詳細資料很少。同類的食慾抑制劑可能造成口乾、失眠、易怒、心跳加快與血壓升高。
sideEffects.zhHans: 关于它的详细数据很少。同类的食欲抑制剂可能造成口干、失眠、易怒、心跳加快与血压升高。

fact.en: Clortermine and chlorphentermine have exactly the same atoms. The only difference is where the chlorine sits on the benzene ring: next to the side chain in clortermine, opposite it in chlorphentermine.
fact.zh: Clortermine 與對氯苯丁胺的原子組成完全相同，唯一的差別是氯原子在苯環上的位置：clortermine 的氯在側鏈旁邊，對氯苯丁胺的氯則在側鏈對面。
fact.zhHans: Clortermine 与对氯苯丁胺的原子组成完全相同，唯一的差别是氯原子在苯环上的位置：clortermine 的氯在侧链旁边，对氯苯丁胺的氯则在侧链对面。
